# proxmox_storage_identity (Data Source)

Reads the storage identity JSON from `/nodes/{node}/storage/{storage}/identity`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_storage_identity" "i" {
  node    = "pve-1"
  storage = "local"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)
- `storage` (String)

### Read-Only

- `identity` (String)
